name: Altered Life (Heritage)
body:
Your unusual nature affects your vitality, bolstering you in ways different from other mortals.

Prerequisite(s): Aberration, fey, ooze, plant, or undead type.

Benefit(s): Choose Wisdom or Charisma. You calculate your bonus hit points per Hit Die based on the chosen ability score instead of your Constitution.
